description: This source file defines the MonkeyNetworkMonitor class used during Android 'monkey' testing to monitor network connectivity changes and gather network usage statistics over time.

classes.name: MonkeyNetworkMonitor
classes.description: A class for monitoring network connectivity during monkey runs, implementing Android's IIntentReceiver to listen for network changes and maintain network usage stats.

methods.name: performReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming intents related to network state changes, updating network stats accordingly.

methods.name: updateNetworkStats
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time since last event and updates counters for mobile and Wi-Fi usage based on last network type.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes network usage tracking, setting counters to zero and recording the start time.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers this receiver with the ActivityManager to start listening for network change broadcasts.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters this receiver from the ActivityManager.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Calls updateNetworkStats to finalize stats collection.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the collected network statistics to Logger.
